# Introduction

This vignette shows how to create a SummarizedExperiment object from a MTX file. 

The important steps are: 

1. load the counts stored into the MTX

2. set rownames and colnames of the matrix 

3. make a SummarizedExperiment object and store the count-matrix into an assay named "counts". 
   This is a standard assay name, and many package rely on this default name so it simplify further processing.

4. eventually parse cell names to extract metadata

5. pre-computing of QC metrics and sizeFactors

6. store object into desired format 


# Example with GSE144136

```{r,message=FALSE}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
```


## step 1-3: load MTX and generate SummarizedExperiment
```{r,message=FALSE}
nagy_mdd_2020 <- function(dir) {
  # Make the SingleCellExperiment object from the count matrix stored in MTX, and add dimnames
  m <- Matrix::readMM(file.path(dir,"GSE144136_GeneBarcodeMatrix_Annotated.mtx.gz"))
  colnames(m) <- read.csv(file.path(dir,"GSE144136_CellNames.csv.gz"),check.names = FALSE,quote="",comment="")$x
  rownames(m) <- read.csv(file.path(dir,"GSE144136_GeneNames.csv.gz"),check.names = FALSE,quote="",comment="")$x
  
  # 
  # This standard naming will 
  m <- SingleCellExperiment(
    list(counts = m)
  )
  m
}
x <- nagy_mdd_2020("apps/geo_download/downloads/GSE144136_bak")
```


## step 4: parse metadata from cell names
```{r}
x <- local({
  # (optional) parse metadata from cell names
  pat <- "^([^\\.]*)\\.(([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_(.*))$"
  x$cell_type <- sub(pat,"\\1",colnames(x))
  x$patient_id <- sub(pat,"\\3",colnames(x))
  x$disease_state <- sub(pat,"\\4",colnames(x))
  x$batch <- sub(pat,"\\5",colnames(x))
  x$barcode_seq <- sub(pat,"\\6",colnames(x))
  x$sex <- "Male"
  x$ethnicity <- "Caucasian"
  x
})
```

## step 5: pre-compute QC metrics and sizeFactors
```{r}
counts(x) <- as(counts(x), "CsparseMatrix") # Change sparse format to improve speed in the next steps
x <- scater::addPerCellQC(x)
x <- scuttle::computeLibraryFactors(x)
```


## step 6: Save object
```{r}
HDF5Array::saveHDF5SummarizedExperiment(x,"datasets/GSE144136.h5se")
ABAData::writeSingleCellExperiment(x, "datasets/GSE144136.h5txt")
```
